notes: User wants rolling latest version like voicehub-1panel: version channel latest, not a pinned 2.4.1 folder.

Database uses the official Halo apps/child service pattern restricted to mysql (1Panel-managed). No bundled mysql container, no MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD form field. PANEL_DB_HOST is declared only in the child selector.
Image lovecards-web-frankenphp:latest is distributed as docker save/load in the official release zip; install.sh loads it. pull_policy: never on the web service.

init.sh translates the 1Panel .env (PANEL_DB_*) into ThinkPHP .env [DATABASE] section at data/web/.env, mounted to /app/.env. Source: .dev/env/.env.example and config/database.php env('database.*') keys.

init.sh seeds data/web/public and data/web/config from the image when index.php is missing. Official release-buildDocker.yml copies those trees into data/web for host mounts; empty host dirs would shadow /app/public and hide index.php.
LoveCards install wizard still imports data.sql and creates lock/RSA. Pre-written .env only supplies connection settings; users complete the web wizard once.
Architectures amd64/arm64: FrankenPHP official base is multi-arch; MySQL is 1Panel-managed so this package no longer depends on mysql:5.7 amd64-only.
